explication: Laravel AI SDK is a unified Laravel-facing API for working with AI providers. A typical request enters through the public API, resolves a capability-specific provider, calls its gateway, and returns a typed response; agents can additionally use tools, streaming, structured output, approvals, and persisted conversations. The README also documents image, audio, transcription, embedding, and other capabilities. Several subsystems are represented at their exact source directories because their implementations were not sampled; their documented capability links use the README as evidence.
